text:
maria: quick thread: we saw p99 token spikes when a global compaction ran during steady traffic. want an io-lease pattern so compactor yields to evictor.
aj: +1, need a simple metric to signal routing (compaction_active).
kevin: compactor consumed disk and stalled async page fetches. propose per-arena compacts by default; global only in maintenance lane.
tim: can we implement an IO token broker? evictor requests tokens, compactor yields if tokens low.
maria: sketch config: 
``ncompaction.mode=per-arena
compaction.global_allowed=false
compaction.io_limit_mb_s=80
compaction.yield_threshold_pct=65
```
aj: test: perf CI with mixed traces and canary 5% rollout. alert if p99 regresses >10%.
infra-bot: queued perf job: io-lease-compaction-canary (run: 2026-03-23_03)
kevin: migration path: roll config via canary, watch compaction_active and p99.
maria: i'll draft RFC follow-up with API for io-token broker and compaction metrics, will ping for review.
